No, you didn't just accidentally skip back to a 2017 meme compilation, this is a 2023 SNES remix of Despacito by Luis Fonsi (ft. Daddy Yankee). Let it be known that I don't understand 90% of the lyrics (despite knowing like 5% Spanish), but Despacito's got an amazing beat, and that's all that really matters.

‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ "Bonus End" Yoshi, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).
